LESSON: FOOD SOURCES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.1: Food sources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Food sources. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. classify food into plant and animal sources, sources of food using computing
2. embrace the different sources of food in their locality. using computing devices. sources and display in class Core-Competence to be developed Critical thinking, Creativity and imagination, Digital literacy, Communication and collaboration 146

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. classify food into plant and animal sources, sources of food using computing
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to classify food into plant and animal sources, sources of food using computing. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. embrace the different sources of food in their locality. using computing devices. sources and display in class Core-Competence to be developed Critical thinking, Creativity and imagination, Digital literacy, Communication and collaboration 146
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to embrace the different sources of food in their locality. using computing devices. sources and display in class Core-Competence to be developed Critical thinking, Creativity and imagination, Digital literacy, Communication and collaboration 146. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Food sources.
2. Explain Food sources to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Food sources.
4. Show that you can: classify food into plant and animal sources, sources of food using computing
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Food sources. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Food sources important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. classify food into plant and animal sources, sources of food using computing
2. embrace the different sources of food in their locality. using computing devices. sources and display in class Core-Competence to be developed Critical thinking, Creativity and imagination, Digital literacy, Communication and collaboration 146

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
